name: Builtin Cluster S04: Tuple Pack, Unpack & Access
description: Tests: tuple_pack, tuple field access via [index], multi-output unpacking, reporter y_values implicit tuple. Foundational tuple operations.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER S04: Tuple Operations
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === 1. TUPLE PACK: combine series into StructArray ===
ret = returns(close)
vol = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
features = (ret, vol, rsi_val)

# === 2. PASS TUPLE TO SLOT-ONLY TRANSFORM (unsupervised) ===
km = kmeans(num_clusters=3, window_size=126, step=63)(features)
cluster = km.cluster_label

# === 3. TUPLE FIELD ACCESS: bracket index on tuple output ===
dist_0 = km.cluster_dists[0]
dist_1 = km.cluster_dists[1]
dist_2 = km.cluster_dists[2]

# === 4. MULTI-OUTPUT UNPACKING: linear_fit returns slope, intercept, residual ===
ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c
fit = linear_fit(window=60)(ref_close, close)
slope_val = fit.slope
resid_val = fit.residual

# === 5. GROUP_BY: returns tuple — extract .value[0] ===
dow = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(index())
grouped = group_by(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(ret, dow)
grouped_ret = grouped.value[0]

# === 6. REPORTER y_values: implicit tuple_pack ===
xy_lines(
    title='Close + Fit Residual',
    category='Tuple Demo',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Residual', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, resid_val))

# === 7. CLUSTER DISTANCES (tuple field access) ===
xy_lines(
    title='Distance to Each Cluster',
    category='Tuple Demo',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Dist Cluster 0', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Dist Cluster 1', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Dist Cluster 2', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(dist_0, dist_1, dist_2))

xy_lines(
    title='K-Means Cluster Label',
    category='Tuple Demo',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cluster', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cluster)
